text: Every day, I follow a consistent routine that keeps me focused and energized. I wake up at six-thirty, and after a quick glass of water, I spend ten minutes stretching. A light breakfast of oatmeal and fruit helps me start the day right. By eight o’clock, I sit down at my desk for work. My schedule is predictable: I handle emails until noon, then tackle my main projects after lunch. In the late afternoon, I go for a thirty-minute run in the park, which clears my head. Evenings are for cooking dinner, reading, and relaxing. I’m in bed by ten-thirty. This structure makes my days feel both stable and productive.
